patterns.note: The hero section prominently features the domain name and a distinct pricing card side-by-side, creating a clear focal point for the primary conversion action.

A single sans-serif font (Inter) is used consistently, with strong size and weight variations to establish a clear typographic hierarchy from large, bold headings to smaller, lighter body text and labels.

A minimalist white background and dark text are contrasted with a vibrant, multi-color gradient accent on the primary conversion element (pricing card) and smaller, functional accent colors for status indicators.
The top navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to the main call to action and language selector as the user scrolls.
Content is organized into distinct, well-spaced sections, with the 'FAQ' section utilizing an accordion pattern for concise information display.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the page during scroll, implemented with standard CSS positioning.
The pricing card features a dynamic, multi-color gradient background that provides a striking visual accent against the otherwise clean and monochromatic layout.
Information is presented in a clear, scannable format using bullet points, checkmark icons, and an expandable accordion for FAQs.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase labels, creating a strong, modern hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to all interactive elements, cards, and input fields, giving a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy overall, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced density within content blocks.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the use of a vibrant, multi-color gradient as the background for the primary pricing and CTA card, which dramatically stands out against the otherwise stark white and dark grey minimalist design. This creates an immediate visual anchor for the conversion goal.
